findings: Compiled RU short fact text and independent multiline EN caption remain readable and distinct from unverified citation metadata at320px.
Current EN preview conditions, step status, canonical record, screen and sequential buttons are localized coherently.
The explicit text-view selector, numbered step controls and selectable activity answers fit narrow viewports without overlap; keyboard focus remains visible.
limitations: These are actual admin editor component captures, not screenshots of the mobile app or authenticated staff shell.
Viewport slices do not show every control simultaneously; long fact citations and some navigation controls continue below the captured viewport.
Desktop read-error notice is an intentional fixture; synthetic citations are not factual verification.
